findings.finding: With the mute off, its gates sit at Q12's Vce(sat) (0.07 V). At the firmware cap (LOUT2 code 26, 0.71 Vpk) a Vth-min 2N7002 (1.0 V at 25 C, -4 mV/K) leaks below threshold on the negative peaks once the box is warm. At 50 C: THD 0.09-0.11 %. At 70 C: THD 0.24-0.39 %, negative peak down 32-63 mV. L->R crosstalk through the shared MUTE_S node is -56 dB (10k sub) / -61 dB (100k) at 1 kHz. With Vth >= 1.5 V, or at 25 C, the line is clean (THD 0.0003 %, crosstalk -116 dB). Round 2's tb_play_cap passes only because its level-1 FET model has no subthreshold current and no tempco.
findings.evidence: docs/review-4/sims/als/mute_corners.py (models_ekv.inc: subthreshold, n 1.5, Ispec 520 uA -> 250 uA at Vth; Vth 1.0/1.5/2.1; 25/50/70 C; sub 10k/100k); out/mute_corners.txt. CJ 2N7002 (C8545) VGS(th) 1.0-2.5 V at 250 uA. Code 24 (-9 dB, 0.50 Vpk) at 70 C, Vth 1.0: THD 0.014 %, 0.9-3.1 mV peak loss.
findings.reference_design: Consumer line-out muting (inverted-mode BJT or JFET) holds the off gate/base below the most negative swing. Ours relies on Vth(min) > peak swing + Vce(sat).
findings.fix: Firmware: SUB_CODE_MAX 26 -> 24 (-9 dB, 0.50 Vpk) in board_lite.c. This costs 3 dB of sub drive (0.35 Vrms at 0 dBFS, enough for typical powered subs at 0.1-0.5 V sensitivity). Or keep 26 and accept 0.4 % THD on tail parts in a hot box, which is inaudible on a sub.
findings.margin: Cap 0.71 Vpk vs onset ~0.6 Vpk at Vth 1.0 / 70 C (negative); +0.5 V at Vth 1.5

findings.finding: The sub cap does not hold during start-up. Lite's DAC_CONTROLSET init (firmware/patches/0001, HIFI_LITE) writes reg 48/49 (LOUT2/ROUT2VOL) = 30, which is 0 dB and 1.41 Vpk. hifi_bsp_route() writes the capped code 26 only 2 s after the codec first acks (codec_ok_at + 2000 ms). The amps are held through this window, but the sub outs are not. Music that starts in this window (LMS resume, a tone) reaches the sub at 0 dB. With Vth-min FETs that gives THD 2.6 % (25 C) to 3.3 % (70 C) and 0.4-0.6 V lost off the negative peak. With Vth 1.5 V: 0.14-0.9 %. With Vth 2.1 V: clean.
findings.evidence: docs/review-4/sims/als/mute_corners.py init_0dB rows; out/mute_corners.txt; patch line DAC_CONTROLSET HIFI_LITE {reg 48 val 30},{reg 49 val 30}; board_lite.c hifi_bsp_route 2000 ms
findings.fix: Firmware: put {"reg":48,"val":26},{"reg":49,"val":26} in the HIFI_LITE DAC_CONTROLSET (0 is better still: let codec_apply raise it). The same init also writes LOUT1/ROUT1 = 28 (-3 dB, above ES8388_OUT1_FULL 27). That is harmless only because the amps are held; set it to 27 too.

findings.finding: Q12's release point on +5V moves about -13 mV/K (Vbe x 142/22). The gate reaches 3 V at +5V = 3.77 V at 25 C, 3.44 V at 50 C and 3.17 V at 70 C. Round 2 assumes the codec output collapses when +5V reaches 3.4 V. Under that assumption, at 70 C with Vth-max (2.5 V) FETs and a 20 ms +5V fall, the gate is only 0.79 V at the collapse and the sub sees -0.33 V. That fails round 2's 0.2 V bound, though it is still 14 dB under the 1.61 V unmuted thump. All other 46 corners: 24-50 mV. If the ES8388 output holds until +5V < 3.0 V (likely: VMID sits on 10 uF), every corner passes.
findings.evidence: docs/review-4/sims/als/mute_powerloss.py (48 corners: 25/50/70 C x Vth 1.0/2.5 x fall 20/2 ms x collapse at 3.4/3.0 V x sub 10k/100k); out/mute_powerloss.txt; Q12 DC sweep in the md
findings.reference_design: Round 2's own fix proposal put the trip at ~4.0 V from a PNP off the reservoir; the as-built divider + NPN Vbe has no reference.
findings.fix: Bring-up test: warm box (~60 C), 10k on J3, scope SUB_L, pull the USB-C during play. Note the +5V level where LOUT2 collapses. If it is >= 3.2 V, change R81 22k -> 20k (C4184, basic): the threshold rises ~0.4 V (70 C: ~3.55 V), which leaves the 5 V-only port's 4.6 V clear above 0 C. Do not go lower: at 0 C a 20k trips at ~4.6 V.
findings.margin: 25 C: 0.37 V between mute-full-on and the assumed collapse; 70 C: -0.23 V

findings.finding: The sub RCA still has no TVS. A discharge into the tip now meets the mute FETs before the codec. Positive strikes avalanche Q13 (~75 V), and the codec side then sees about 1 A instead of round 2's ~19 A. Negative strikes drag MUTE_S to about -80 to -110 V through Q13's body diode. The gate follows only in part, so Vgs reaches 31.5 V at -8 kV contact (abs max 20 V), 17.8 V at -2 kV, and 16.9 V from a -325 V Y-capacitor ground (centre pin making contact before the sleeve with a Class-II charger or sub). Gate-oxide margin is thin at the IEC level.
findings.evidence: docs/review-4/sims/als/mute_esd.py (IEC 150 pF/330 ohm +-2/8 kV; 2.2 nF at +-325 V via 10 ohm; 75 V avalanche, Q12 junction clamp, 10 nH SUB_MUTE trace); out/mute_esd.txt. With a 6 V bidirectional TVS: Vgs <= 5.2 V, codec side <= 0.07 A.
findings.reference_design: RCA line outs on commercial receivers carry a TVS or a series R of 470R-1k at the jack.
findings.fix: One PESD5V0S2BT (LCSC C49338, SOT-23, dual bidirectional 5 V, extended, 22k in stock) at J3: pin 1 to SUB_L, pin 2 to SUB_R, pin 3 to GND next to J3 pin 2. Place it between J3 and Q13/Q15.
findings.margin: -8 kV: 31.5 V vs 20 V abs max (oxide typically breaks at 2-3x); -2 kV: 2.2 V under

findings.finding: Still no ESD protection on USB D+/D- or CC1/CC2 at J1 (root.py: D1 SMBJ22A on VBUS only). The laptop bring-up and every charger plug-in go through this jack.
findings.reference_design: Espressif DevKitC / CH340 boards fit a USBLC6-2 or ESD diodes at the connector
findings.fix: As round 2: USBLC6-2SC6 (C7519) on D+/D- at J1, and 22 V-rated ESD on CC1/CC2 if space allows.

findings.finding: The Lite firmware's scale constants are still stale. LINE_DIVIDER is 2.0 but R30/R31 15k/10k is 2.5. HIFI_HAS_TAPS is 0 though R66-R69 are fitted. The PIN_AMP_SDZ comment still says 100k (R54 is 10k). Captures will read 1.9 dB off, and the loopback taps are off by default.
findings.fix: LINE_DIVIDER 2.5 (or the loaded value from R3-AUDIO-5), HIFI_HAS_TAPS 1 for this revision

findings.finding: The mute ECO's layout passes. Netlist pins match root.py. CPL rotation and pin 1 of the 9 new parts land on the board pads (cpl_pin1: 154 fitted, 0 FAIL). Its two CHECKs are Q14 (drain on GND, intended) and U8 (known). No GND islands (31 fragments in 1 group). The fragments the ECO cut are stitched: R37/Q14 GND 2 vias on F.Cu plus a 5-via B.Cu fragment; R39's 6.6 mm2 F.Cu piece has 1 via plus the B.Cu fragment. Sub nets sit >= 7.6 mm from BUCK5_SW. SUB_L-SUB_R spacing is 1.8 mm. SUB_R grew to 27 mm, harmless at 100R source impedance. JLC stock: all 6 lines are basic parts with 0.8-3.8 M in stock.

Cold-start sub thump (round 2's known unknown). The VMID ramp (reg0 = 0x05, 50k, C39 10 uF, tau 125-250 ms) gives 0.32-0.90 V at the RCA but only 22-45 mV after a sub's 20 Hz high-pass. That passes against 0.14 V. If a driver used the 5k fast VMID, it would be 0.19 V.

Thermal at the 9 W/ch governor limit (thermal_out_w 18 W, tau 30 s) passes. Into 6 ohm: 1.22 A rms, 2 x 168 mOhm hot -> 0.50 W/ch, plus 0.64 W idle and ~0.2 W switching = ~1.8 W, so Tj ~ 62 + 1.8 x 22 = 102 C. Into 4 ohm: ~2.15 W, Tj ~109 C. The governor assumes 4 ohm and -3 dB LOUT1 (actually -4.5 dB), so it is conservative for 6 ohm. DJ-direct bypasses the governor but is capped at 5.4 Vrms (7.3 W/4 ohm, 4.9 W/6 ohm) by the codec caps.
findings.evidence: hifi_gov.c hifi_gov_cfg_lite; TPA3118 SLOS708G Rds(on); round-1 62 C box; R3-AUDIO-4 DJ level

round2_fixes_checked.how: Parts and nets in root.py, .net and .kicad_pcb match: Q11 diode +5V->MUTE_RES, Q12 C on SUB_MUTE, Q13/Q15 D on SUB_L/SUB_R, Q14 D on GND. Round 2's benches re-run and pass (tb_play_cap peak 0.711 V, mute 0.075 V; tb_powerloss -25 mV). Broken at corners: R4-ALS-1 (subthreshold, warm), R4-ALS-3 (hot release point), R4-ALS-4 (ESD).
Holds after hifi_bsp_route, but DAC_CONTROLSET init writes 30 (0 dB) for >= 2 s (R4-ALS-2).
hifi_gov.c thermal_out_w 18 W total, tau 30 s; Tj ~102-109 C (R4-ALS-9).

round2_fixes_checked.id: R3-SYSTEM-5 L4 (amps held until codec settles)
round2_fixes_checked.how: hifi_main.c: amp_on false until codec_up + 2500 ms; codec_up set when codec_apply succeeds.
gnd_islands.py: 1 GND group, no islands; ECO fragments stitched by 1-5 vias (R4-ALS-7).

field_issues.issue: Line-out thump into a separately powered sub at power loss
field_issues.source: R3-AUDIO-2; common on ESP32-A1S / LyraT-style boards used as line sources
field_issues.how: Mute: 24-50 mV in 46 of 48 corners; -0.33 V at 70 C with Vth-max FETs and a late codec collapse (R4-ALS-3).

field_issues.issue: Plugging RCA cables with a Class-II (Y-cap) charger or sub: the centre pin makes contact first and discharges up to ~325 V peak
field_issues.source: Y-capacitor leakage, IEC 60065 touch current; common hum/pop-on-plug reports
field_issues.how: mute_esd.py: Vgs 16.9 V vs 20 V; TVS fix in R4-ALS-4.

field_issues.issue: 2N7002 used as an analog shunt passes signal when the swing goes below -Vth (body diode / reverse channel)
field_issues.source: onsemi AND9093 (MOSFET in analog switch use); forum threads on MOSFET mutes

field_issues.issue: USB-C 5 V-only laptop port: board must still boot and sub mute stay off
field_issues.how: Q12 holds SUB_MUTE at 0.10 V at 4.6 V and 0 C (0.58 V at -20 C).
+5V stays >= 4.6 V, so the mute stays off. A hard reset (VBUS to 0) is a power loss, which the mute covers.
